page_title: BOL 2-2 ROM | Bologna v AS Roma 12/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's the end of the match.
90+8' 2 - 2 Goal! Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Lukasz Skorupski to commit before slotting the penalty into the bottom left corner.
90+7' Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
90+6' The AS Roma players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
90+5' Jhon Lucumi (Bologna) goes into the referee's book for dissent.
90+5' There's a break in play and referee Rosario Abisso must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by AS Roma using VAR. This could be interesting!
90+4' The referee gives a yellow card to Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) for talking back. He must be careful for the remainder of the match.
90+4' That looked a certain handball by Jhon Lucumi (Bologna) inside the box, but the ref wasn't having it and just played on. NO penalty!
90+4' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) beats the defender to the ball in the box and shoots, but the ball flashes just wide of the left post.
90+4' Angelino (AS Roma) prepares to take a corner kick.
90+3' Shots on target – 8:3.
90+1' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) takes the corner with a short pass.
90+1' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Vincenzo Italiano has decided to make a change. Samuel Iling Junior (Bologna) replaces Benjamin Dominguez.
89' Substitution. Emil Holm leaves the pitch and is replaced by Stefan Posch (Bologna).
88' Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
86' Tommaso Baldanzi (AS Roma) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
84' Claudio Ranieri has decided to substitute Paulo Dybala and he is replaced by Tommaso Baldanzi (AS Roma).
84' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Alexis Saelemaekers departs the field of play to be replaced by Nicola Zalewski (AS Roma).
82' The referee blows his whistle as Jens Odgaard (Bologna) was too aggressive in his challenge.
81' The foul by Alexis Saelemaekers (AS Roma) was seen by Rosario Abisso who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
81' 13:9 – the total goal attempt statistics.
78' Substitution. Thijs Dallinga makes way for Santiago Castro (Bologna).
78' Substitution. Mats Hummels walks off the pitch and Zeki Celik (AS Roma) comes on as a substitute.
78' Here comes a substitution. Leandro Paredes is given a rest as he is replaced by Niccolo Pisilli (AS Roma).
78' Claudio Ranieri prepares a substitution. Lorenzo Pellegrini is replaced by Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma).
77' Thijs Dallinga (Bologna) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
76' The linesman points to the corner flag, Bologna are going to take it.
76' Jens Odgaard (Bologna) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the left side of the target, but Mile Svilar easily deals with the threat.
74' Lukasz Skorupski leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Paulo Dybala (AS Roma).
73' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
71' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) jinks his way past multiple challenges and fires from the edge of the box to the middle of the goal, but Mile Svilar is equal to it.
71' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
70' Emil Holm (Bologna) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
69' The referee blows his whistle for a foul after Mats Hummels (AS Roma) overruns the ball during an attack and makes an aggressive challenge on his opponent.
68' Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Rosario Abisso saw the whole situation.
68' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) will replace Dan Ndoye.
67' Good defending. Thijs Dallinga (Bologna) tries to find Jens Odgaard inside the box, but the pass is cut out.
65' 2 - 1 Goal! Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Mile Svilar into right side of the goal.
65' Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) is going to take the penalty!
64' Referee Rosario Abisso is happy with his original decision after the VAR review. It’s a PENALTY to Bologna!
64' Hang on! It might not be a penalty for Bologna as the ref now wants to review using VAR. This hopefully won't take too long.

63' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation. The referee gives a penalty kick to Bologna!!
63' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Bologna.

61' 1 - 1 Goal! Jens Odgaard produces a great pass that finds Thijs Dallinga (Bologna) inside the penalty area, who takes advantage of the situation to rifle a shot past the goalkeeper and into the back of the net. 1:1.
60' Corner kicks – 2:2.
58' 0 - 1 GOAL after a blunder! Keeper Lukasz Skorupski makes a complete hash of a weak mid range shot from Alexis Saelemaekers (AS Roma) and let’s the ball squirm into the net. It’s now 0:1.
57' Remo Freuler (Bologna) produces a good strike that sails to the middle of the goal, but his effort ends up in the goalkeeper's gloves.
56' A cross by Dan Ndoye (Bologna) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
54' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom left corner, but Mile Svilar has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
51' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
50' A rebound falls at the feet of Manu Kone (AS Roma) on the edge of the box, but his powerful shot veers well wide of the left post.

49' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity.
47' Rosario Abisso blows his whistle as Jens Odgaard (Bologna) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45+1' Benjamin Dominguez (Bologna) goes close to scoring with a shot from inside the box, but he drags his effort wide of the left post.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
45' The corner from Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) is cleared away by the defence.
44' Alexis Saelemaekers (AS Roma) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
43' Rosario Abisso interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Thijs Dallinga (Bologna).
42' The resulting corner from Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
40' The total number of attempts is 3:6.
37' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) takes a shot from the edge of the area, but it goes harmlessly wide of the right post.
36' Juan Miranda (Bologna) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
35' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) pounces on a pass inside the box but flashes his shot just over the bar. That was a great chance!
32' Juan Miranda (Bologna) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
31' A brilliant cross into the box finds Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma), who directs his header to the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper shows his reflexes and makes an astonishing save.

31' A nice sequence of play ends with a shot by Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) from the edge of the box. The effort, however, is towards the middle of the goal where Lukasz Skorupski easily catches the ball.
31' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
27' The game is interrupted as Manu Kone (AS Roma) is flagged offside.
26' The ball is cleared after Dan Ndoye (Bologna) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
25' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Angelino (AS Roma), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
25' Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
22' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
20' Total attempts – 2:0.
17' Remo Freuler (Bologna) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Rosario Abisso blows his whistle for an infringement.
16' Some patient build-up play from Bologna as they look to unlock the defence.
13' Jens Odgaard (Bologna) is flagged for offside.
12' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
11' Bologna get a corner.

10' Thijs Dallinga (Bologna) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the right side of the goal. However, Mile Svilar anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save.
10' Emil Holm (Bologna) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
9' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
7' Flag up against Benjamin Dominguez (Bologna). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
7' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Juan Miranda (Bologna), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
6' The game is interrupted, a clear handball by Alexis Saelemaekers (AS Roma).
4' Alexis Saelemaekers (AS Roma) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
3' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Emil Holm (Bologna).

1' Thijs Dallinga (Bologna) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the middle of the goal. His effort, however, is blocked by Mile Svilar, who pulls off a comfortable save!
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
AS Roma will kick the game off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Rosario Abisso.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
